## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks run and relevant results. Distinguish synthetic tests from live
interoperability evidence. Explain any checks that could not be run.

## Review notes

Mention contract changes, migrations, rollout considerations, or remaining
limitations that a reviewer needs to assess.

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Generated API/source inventory files are current where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, sessions, customer data, or raw captures are included.
